item.title: Isuzu introduces lower-priced D-Max AT
item.description: Isuzu Philippines has introduced the D-Max LS 4x2 AT, a new variant that gives pickup buyers a more affordable automatic transmission option without having to step up to the more expensive 3.0-liter models.

item.title: Honda honors top dealership talent
item.description: Honda Cars Philippines named the winners of its 2026 National Skills Contest after dealership personnel from across the country competed in technical repair and customer service categories on 21 October.

item.title: Suzuki posts record September sales
item.description: Suzuki Motor Corporation reported record global sales and production for September 2026, with strong results in India helping the Japanese automaker post double-digit growth in both categories.

item.title: BMW 3 Series adds i3
item.description: BMW has given its 3 Series an electric option for the first time, with the new i3 joining petrol-powered models in the sedan’s eighth generation.

item.title: Hyundai climbs Interbrand rankings
item.description: Hyundai Motor has moved up to fourth place among automotive brands in Interbrand’s Best Global Brands 2026 ranking, while also climbing to 29th among the world’s leading brands.

item.title: Mitsubishi Outlander gets tougher
item.description: Mitsubishi Motors is preparing a more off-road-capable version of its Outlander SUV, with the 2028 Diamond Trail Edition scheduled for its world debut at the SEMA Show in Las Vegas from 3 to 6 November.

item.title: 7 Luxury Vehicles From Throughout History That Used 4-Cylinder Engines
item.description: From cars produced at the turn of the 20th century to modern luxury SUVs, these seven cars prove that 4-pots were quietly always a part of luxury car history.

item.title: Can One Tire Really Do It All? 8 All-Weather Tires Compete To Find Out
item.description: Traditionally, tires that try to do it all have recorded indifferent performances. But in this test, two all-weather tires stood out among the rest.

item.title: Byron Wins Martinsville with Dominant Run as NASCAR Championship Battle Extends to Homestead
item.description: William Byron will not go winless in 2026, winning the season’s penultimate race at Martinsville and leading 362 of 500 laps.
